name: fintrack-monorepo
description: FinTrack - Production-Style MERN Personal Finance Tracker Microservices Application

scripts.test: npm run test:auth && npm run test:transaction && npm run test:notification && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:gateway && npm run lint:auth && npm run lint:transaction && npm run lint:notification && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix gateway ci && npm --prefix services/auth-service ci && npm --prefix services/transaction-service ci && npm --prefix services/notification-service ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['.env','gateway/.env','services/auth-service/.env','services/transaction-service/.env','services/notification-service/.env','frontend/.env'].forEach(f=>{const src=f.replace(/\.env$/,'.env.example'); if(!fs.existsSync(f) && fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src, f); console.log('Created ' + f);}});"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n auth,trans,notif,gate,front -c yellow,blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix services/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/transaction-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/notification-service run dev" "npm --prefix gateway run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n auth,trans,notif,gate,front -c yellow,blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix services/auth-service start" "npm --prefix services/transaction-service start" "npm --prefix services/notification-service start" "npm --prefix gateway start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"

author: Aditya Tiwari
